title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 49 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 49)

content.overview: Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.glance: Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.study:
Statutory rule: Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.

Operative conditions: Identify the Convention/foreign-award condition, documentary requirement or enforcement ground and apply it precisely.
